notes: Astrophysics is an optional focus area within the BS, Physics (PY29) degree. Full requirement set = standard BS Physics core plus five restricted electives drawn from the astrophysics focus list. Focus list verified verbatim.

buckets.label: Upper-Division Lab
buckets.note: One from PHYS 122, 124, 133, 173, or ASTR 150 (4 units).

buckets.label: Restricted Electives (Astrophysics focus)
buckets.note: Five restricted electives (20 units), 4+ units each; max two from outside physics. Catalog verbatim: 'Astrophysics: PHYS 160, 161, 162, 225A-B-C, 227, 228; ECE 120; MAE 180, ASTR 123, 150.'

buckets.label: Total Units for the Major
buckets.note: 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division units (same as base BS). Minimum total-unit requirement for the BS Physics with Specialization in Astrophysics (PY29): 109 units = 52 lower-division + 57 upper-division, identical to the base BS Physics. This is a unit-count minimum, not a distinct course set — the qualifying courses are those in the other buckets (lower-div physics core, lower-div math, upper-div core, upper-div lab, and the five astrophysics restricted electives). No separate course list applies.
